question: National Pollution Prevention Day is observed on ______ annually in the memory of people who lost their lives in Bhopal gas tragedy.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2 December.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **National Pollution Prevention Day** is mentioned every year on** December 2 in memory of the people who lost their lives in the 1984 Bhopal Gas Tragedy.**
 
• The dreadful industrial accident occurred because of the **leak of Methyl Isocyanate gas in the Union Carbide India Limited (UCIL) pesticide plant on the night of December 2–3.**
 
• It is as well the day to raise **awareness about the danger of air pollution.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **World Environment Day** is celebrated yearly on** 5 June,** for encouraging consciousness and action for the protection of the environment. **​ **
 
• **International Day for the Preservation of the Ozone Layer** is celebrated on **September 16 planned by the United Nations General Assembly.**
 
• **World Water Day** is a yearly United Nations observance day celebrated on **22 March that highlights the importance of fresh water. **
